name: terra
tagline: Made of the places we love.
description: A material-led identity for a sustainable building studio. A layered hill, clay-rich color, and tactile typographic contrast put landscapes at the heart of the system.
heading: lora
rules: Hill layers are offset but share one continuous lower edge.
Build compositions from horizontal strata with unequal heights.
Use earth text on limestone for all technical explanations.

system.concept: Stratified clay objects, contour-like architecture, raw material studies, and grounded serif contrasts. The identity keeps the landscape visibly present in every application.
headline: Good places.
Made from good ground.
system.productNote: A place, understood from the ground.
features: An approach shaped by the landscape and the life already there.
Honest surfaces, local character, and carefully considered form.
Thoughtful decisions for the way a place will be lived in.
system.layoutNote: Limestone hero with earth serif type and layered clay architecture. Horizontal unequal-height sections, weathered-green annotations, and generous project imagery.
